subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do the workflow and security owners accept these 14 upstream action revisions for secret-bearing, code-scanning, automation, and release jobs after completing the required Codex source inspection?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but the replacement commits execute with high-value credentials and publishing capabilities; repository tests cannot decide whether maintainers trust those upstream revisions.

options.title: Approve after source review
options.body: Verify the upstream commits, direct Codex contract, and exact-head workflows, then merge the unchanged pin-only patch.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate Codex, token-creation, Docker-publishing, and CodeQL revisions from lower-risk setup and housekeeping actions for narrower review.

options.title: Hold current pins
options.body: Retain the existing revisions until owners can review the upstream changes or a newer grouped update replaces this one.

recommendation.title: Approve after source review
recommendation.body: Verify the upstream commits, direct Codex contract, and exact-head workflows, then merge the unchanged pin-only patch.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across the affected Codex-agent and release workflows and are already subscribed to this PR.
